[[File:Omniprobe_Sensor_Array.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Omniprobe Sensor Array]]
An '''omniprobe sensor probe''' was a ground-based [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that emitted a beam that hugged the ground, using a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] forces to hug the ground, collecting data on targets behind rough landscapes and blind spots.
